voices.name: 巴別塔・博士
voices.description: Designed voice for the Doctor in the Babel fan dub: younger adult man, gentle, restrained, scholarly, slightly tired. Created with Voice Design, no cloning.

voices.name: 巴別塔・夢中的巨人
voices.description: Babel fan dub: dream giantess reciting the prophecy. Low, hollow, slow, chant-like female voice.

voices.name: 巴別塔・女性路人乙
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: shared young female voice (new medical staff member). Higher, youthful, earnest.

voices.name: 巴別塔・女性路人甲
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: shared female commoner voice (cautious civilian). Lively, gossipy, slightly husky.

voices.name: 巴別塔・奴隸商人
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: slave trader at the Scar Market. Thin, dry, cynical streetwise male voice.

voices.name: 巴別塔・好運
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: "Lucky", a burly but timid commoner. Ordinary slightly rough male voice, talkative everyman.

voices.name: 巴別塔・好運的妻子
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: Lucky's future wife, a Babel member. Lively, kind, practical young woman.

voices.name: 巴別塔・孽茨雷
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: Nezzsalem, king of the Nachzehrer. Very deep, slow, gravelly elderly bass with heavy pauses.

voices.name: 巴別塔・尤莉葉
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Yulie, veteran assassin. Lower-mid, plain, steady, tired female voice.

voices.name: 巴別塔・尤莉葉（成熟版）
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Yulie, hardened veteran assassin. Low, dry, weathered alto. Chosen by the owner (version C of round two).

voices.name: 巴別塔・旁白
voices.description: Designed narrator voice for the Babel fan dub: adult woman telling the story to one listener, natural speaking rhythm, calm and slightly wistful. Created with Voice Design, no cloning.

voices.name: 巴別塔・曼弗雷德
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Manfred, young officer. Clear, firm, earnest baritone.

voices.name: 巴別塔・曼弗雷德（成熟版）
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Manfred, seasoned commander. Low, grave, restrained baritone. Chosen by the owner (version C of round two).

voices.name: 巴別塔・曼弗雷德（第三版）
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Manfred, restrained and loyal strongman who is earnest and fussy. Chosen by the owner (version C of round three).

voices.name: 巴別塔・曼弗雷德（第三輪乙）
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Manfred candidate B of round three, the lowest and steadiest of the three; kept for comparison at the owner's request.

voices.name: 巴別塔・杜卡雷
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: Duq'arael, lord of the Vampire court. Silky, languid aristocratic baritone, courteous sarcasm.

voices.name: 巴別塔・特雷西斯
voices.description: Designed voice for Theresis in the Babel fan dub: middle-aged man, composed veteran general, few plain words, weary but warm underneath. Created with Voice Design, no cloning.

voices.name: 巴別塔・男性路人甲
voices.description: Babel fan dub: generic male soldier voice for nameless minor characters (first used for the unnamed assassin).

voices.name: 巴別塔・疤眼
voices.description: Babel fan dub: Scar-eye, cyclops broker. Deep, rough, world-weary male bass.

voices.name: 巴別塔・粗野傭兵
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: shared rough male voice (wounded mercenary, fierce commoner). Hoarse, coarse, short-tempered.

voices.name: 巴別塔・菈瑪蓮
voices.description: Arknights Babel fan dub: Lamalian, lady of the Banshee court. Low warm mezzo, musical, gentle and quietly witty.
